title: Unlacquered Brass 3-Tier Wall Mount Towel Shelf, 24.7-Inch Hotel-Style Drying Rack, Brass, Allied Brass
description:
Want a neater bathroom without sacrificing space? This 3-tier hotel-style towel shelf adds organized storage and a convenient drying rack while keeping the floor clear in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. The wall mount design suits traditional bathroom hardware and pairs easily with classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures.

- Store folded towels and linens on a space-saving towel shelf
- Dry and hang towels across three rack-style arms
- Wall-mounted installation with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Brass construction for a lasting, refined presence
- 

Specs: Dimensions 24.7 in L x 10.4 in H x 8.9 in W; projection 3.5 in. Mounting type: wall mount. Assembly: some assembly required. Included items: towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware. Product weight: 5.6 lb; shipping weight: 7 lb. Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Synonyms: towel shelf, towel rack, towel holder.
